head_commit.message:
fix(sjasmplus): match signed 32-bit shifts and intermediates

Match measured SjASMPlus arithmetic before enclosing shifts, comparisons and division. Preserve bare label identity for banked entries and reject oversized numeric literals. Replay 646 native cases, CLI preservation and five-host package qualification; add bounded live Linux corroboration in the existing ecosystem capture. Fixes #714.
